site.description: Name of the site on the Artalk server

page_key.description: Unique identifier of the page. Uses the path of the page if not set

locale.description: Language of Artalk, e.g., en, zh-CN, or auto

dark_mode.description: Dark mode: true, false, or 'auto' to follow the system color scheme. Follows the appearance of the theme (the data-appearance attribute of <html>) if not set
